ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.
   C. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.
   C. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Dua before and after waking up.? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dua before and after waking up..
   C. Use Dua before and after waking up. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Dua before and after waking up. has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.
   B. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.
   B. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

10. Which response best shows understanding of Milad un-Nabi? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Milad un-Nabi has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Milad un-Nabi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Milad un-Nabi.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic etiquettes: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Islamic etiquettes: has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   C. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

14. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on swalah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Iman and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Love and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic etiquettes: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Dua before and after waking up. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
